_about: Baked light for the static world (tools/blender/bake_static_world.py), world axes as courses/ascot.json. Each image stores value / scale, sRGB-encoded. Viewer: colour = material colour x light x scale (light maps), or image x scale (ground; its area is in world x, z, image top = north). 'outside' and 'turf' are the plain grass and turf colours (linear) to carry on beyond the baked ground.
